concept_options.title: AI Gets Cheaper, Stakes Get Bigger
concept_options.hook: AI got cheaper at the edge—and more expensive at the center.
concept_options.visual_approach: Stock-photo editorial montage with cyan/amber split lines, source tags, and native data cards.
concept_options.target_audience: General technology and business news viewers
concept_options.core_message: Access is spreading, but the stakes around AI are growing faster.
concept_options.cta: Watch what scales next: access, capital, rules, or consequences.
concept_options.why_this_works: It gives five distinct headlines one memorable tension while preserving source caveats.

concept_options.title: Five Signals From AI Week
concept_options.hook: Five headlines show where AI is headed next.
concept_options.visual_approach: Chronological five-card newsroom treatment with one stock image per item.
concept_options.core_message: This week's news spans the whole AI stack.
concept_options.why_this_works: High clarity, but it is less cohesive and less memorable than c1.

concept_options.title: From Laptop to Law
concept_options.hook: AI moved from your laptop to the rulebook this week.
concept_options.visual_approach: A continuous line travels through device, server, capital, EU, and booking interfaces over stock photography.
concept_options.core_message: AI is becoming both local and institutional.
concept_options.cta: Ask where the next boundary will be.
concept_options.why_this_works: The visual journey is strong but gives less room to the OpenAI access claim.

selected_concept.rationale: Approved because the edge-versus-center tension creates a coherent argument rather than a generic list.

tools.why_this_provider: Live search is required and reaches current primary/news sources.

stages.approach: Lock changing claims to dated URLs and preserve caveats.

stages.approach: Acquire verified non-premium stock, synthesize section narration, normalize and manifest all files.
stages.fallback_if_unavailable: Use another verified free stock image or document missing optional music; never use premium assets silently.

tools.why_this_provider: Best fit for deterministic data cards, typography, and stock motion.

stages.approach: Hand-author a project-local composition, render, then run full media and content validation.

quality_tradeoffs.tradeoff: Local Piper narration versus premium cloud TTS
quality_tradeoffs.quality_impact: Less expressive than premium neural direction, but consistent, local, and approved.

alternative_paths.description: Premium cloud voice with otherwise identical edit
alternative_paths.what_changes: Narration provider and performance control only.

production_plan.art_direction: Obsidian newsroom field, cyan for access, amber for stakes, condensed headline typography, editorial source labels, and one connective signal line that changes state between scenes.

taste_profile.design_read: A calm, high-information financial-news package with photographic depth and restrained technological motion.
taste_profile.palette_discipline: Obsidian, white, cyan, amber; story-specific red only for the agent boundary.
taste_profile.layout_variation: Alternate full-bleed, split, tunnel, and editorial-card arrangements while retaining the signal line.
taste_profile.reference_strategy: Use primary-source language and stock-photo metaphor; no imitation of a named studio.
anti_patterns: stock subject represented as story participant
quality_gates: no full draft before assets review

music_source.mood_direction: restrained instrumental technology pulse, calm intro and gradual build

voice_selection.rationale: Local, intelligible, approved representative sample, zero spend.
voice_selection.delivery_style: measured newsroom narrator with crisp statistics and restrained urgency
voice_selection.pacing_policy: Use section-local pauses; do not time-stretch the voice; allow breathing room in the edit.
